senses.gloss:
m. (-सः)
A cage, a net, a chain or any apparatus for confining beasts or birds.
E.
वि before तसि to adorn, aff. घञ्; also वीतंस.

m. (-सः)
1 A cage, a chain or net, &c. for confining birds or beasts.
2 An enclosure for tranquillising or taming them, an aviary, a menagerie.
3 A place for keeping game, a preserve.
E.
वि before तसि to adorn, aff. घञ्, and the vowel of the prefix made long.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A sort of lock or bolt with three divisions or wards.
2 An elephant.
f. (-ण्डा)
1 Controversy, argument, the subversion of another's opinion or interpretation, and establishment of one's own.
2 Criticism.
3 An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)
4 Benzoin or styrax (?)
5 The Oleander plant, (Nerium odorum.)
6 A ladle, a spoon.
E.
वि before तडि to beat, aff. अच् and टाप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Stretched, spread, expanded.
2 Pervaded, diffused.
3 Lengthened.
n. (-तं)
Any stringed instrument.
E.
वि before तत stretched.

f. (-तिः)
1 Spreading, expansion.
2 Quantity, collection.
3 A clump, a cluster, (of trees, &c.)
E.
वि before तन to stretch, and क्तिन् aff.

n. (-णं)
Spreading, stretching.
E.
वितत, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stretched, spread, expanded.
E.
वितत the same, कृत made, and च्चि augment, leaving ई.

ind.
Having spread.
E.
वि before तन to spread, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
False, untrue.
E.
वि implying reverse, तथ्य true, अच् aff., and the semivowel rejected; or वि before तम to desire, क्थन् aff., and म rejected.

f. (-द्रुः)
The name of a river, said to be situated in the Punjab.
E.
वि before तम to desire, aff. रु, and दङ् augment.

mfn. (-नुः-न्वी-नु)
Thin, graceful, delicate.
E.
वि, and तनु the same.

m. (-न्तुः)
A good horse.
f. (-न्तुः)
A widow.

mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वती-न्वत्)
Spreading, stretching, expanding.
E.
वि before तन to stretch, शतृ aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Gift, donation.
2 Abandoning, quitting.
2 Passing, crossing.
E.
वि implying privation, &c., and तॄ to cross, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-माः-माः-मः)
1 Light, free from darkness.
2 Exempt from the quality of ignorance.
E.
वि priv. तमस् darkness.

m. (-र्कः)
1 Reasoning, discussion.
2 Doubt, deliberation.
3 A teacher, an instructor in divine knowledge.
4 Consideration of probabilities, mental anticipation of alternatives, conjecture.
E.
वि implying discrimination, &c., तर्क to reason or doubt, aff. अच्.

n. (-णं)
1 Reasoning, discussion, whether mental or controversial, argument, reflection.
2 Apprehension, doubt.
E.
वि before तर्क to reason, aff. ल्युट्.

ind.
Having deliberated, considered, &c.
mfn. (-र्क्यः-र्क्या-र्क्यं)
Doubtful, questionable.
E.
वि before तर्क to reason, ल्यप् or यत् aff.

f. (-र्द्धिः-र्द्धी)
1 A quadrangular building, or sort of covered terrace of wood in the centre of the court-yard of a temple or palace.
2 A quadrangular resting place made of wood, a seat, a bench.
3 A place in a court-yard for sitting in or standing under.
4 A floor on four posts in the midst of a quadrangular house.
5 A temporary stage or shed in the middle of a court-yard, for performing sacrifices, representing plays, &c.
6 A terrace furnished with pillars, a verandah, a balcony.
7 A covered temporary terrace on which idols are sometimes placed and worshipped.
E.
वि privative, तर्द to injure, aff. इन्; also ङीष् optionally added, and with कन् added in the fem. form वितर्द्धिका.

n. (-लं)
One of the seven divisions of Pātāla, the second in descent below the earth.
E.
वि before तल to be low or deep, aff. अच्.

f. (-स्तिः)
A long span measured by the extended thumb and little finger, considered equal to twelve fingers.
E.
वि apart, तस to throw, Uṇādi aff. ति.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Empty, pithless, sapless.
2 Empty, vacant.
3 Dull, stupid.
4 Wicked, abandoned.
mn. (-नः-नं)
1 Spreading, expansion.
2 An awning, a canopy.
3 Sacrifice, offering, oblation.
4 The sacrificial hearth or hole in which the sacred fires are kept.
5 A heap, a quantity.
n. (-नं)
1 A form of the metre Anuṣṭubh, or verse of four lines of eight syllables each; each line of the stanza named Vitāna consists of two Iambics, one Trochee, and one Spondee.
2 Leisure, rest, interval of occupation.
E.
वि before तन to spread, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-नौ)
The sides or cartilages of the larynx.

n. (-कं)
1 An awning, a canopy, especially a cloth spread over a large open hall or court, or any open space in which dancing, singing, &c. are exhibited, at solemn or [] religious festivals.
2 A heap, a quantity.
3 An expanse.
E.
कन added to the preceding.

n. (-णं)
Covering, overspreading, (as a canopy.)
E.
वितान, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Spread or extended over, (as a canopy.)
E.
वितान, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being overspread, covered, shaded, &c.
E.
वि before तन to stretch, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Staying, being.
2 Fixed, stationary.
3 Permanent.
E.
वि before स्था to stay, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Crossed, overpassed.
2 Subdued, overcome.
3 Effaced, rubbed out.
4 Conferred, bestowed.
5 Afforded, yielded.
E.
वि before तॄ to cross, क्त aff.

n. (-न्नं)
1 A potherb, (Marsilia quadrifolia.)
2 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.)
E.
वि privative, तुन्न pained, tortured; allaying pain.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)
n. (-कं)
1 Coriander seed.
2 Blue vitriol.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Displeased, dissatisfied.
E.
वि priv., तुष्ट pleased.

mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं)
Content, satisfied, free from desire.
E.
वि priv., तृष्णा thirst.

f. (-ता)
1 Satiety, satisfaction.
2 Content.
E.
वि priv., तृष्णता cupidity.

r. 10th cl. (वित्तयति)
To quit, to abandon, especially by giving away, to give alms.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Judged, investigated, examined, discussed.
2 Known, notorious, famous.
3 Gained, acquired.
n. (-त्तं)
Wealth, property, thing, substance.
E.
विद to know, to discuss, to acquire, aff. क्त, form irr.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone, departed.
2 Exempt or freed from.
3 Loosed, let go, unbound.
4 Tranquil, quiet, tame.
m. (-तः)
1 A horse or elephant, untrained to or unfit for war.
2 Goading an elephant.
E.
वी to go, aff. क्त.

m. (-दः)
A benefactor, one who gives away property.
E.
वित्त wealth, and द who gives.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Rich, wealthy.
E.
वित्त, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Poor, indigent.
E.
वित्त, and हीन void of.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Discussion, discrimination, judgment, investigation.
2 Knowledge.
3 Gain, acquisition.
4 Probability, likelihood.
E.
विद to know, &c., aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-तिः)
1 Going, moving, motion.
2 Eating.
3 Engendering, producing.
4 Cleaning, cleansing.
5 Light, lustre.
m. (-तिः)
A horse.
E.
वी to go, क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.

f. (-हा)
Cupidity, avarice.
E.
वित्त, and ईहा wish.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ती-स्तं)
Frightened, alarmed, afraid.
E.
वि before त्रस to fear, aff. क्त.

m. (-सः)
Fear, alarm.
E.
वि before त्रास fear.

m. (-नः)
An ox.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Free from sin or soil.
E.
वीत, and कल्मष sin.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Free from desire.
E.
वीत, and काम desire.

mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं)
Humble, lowly, not proud.
E.
वीत gone, दम्भ pride, &c.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fearless, undaunted.
E.
वीत, and भष fear.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
1 Exempt from passions or affections.
2 Bleached, colourless.
m. (-गः)
1 Any sage with subdued passions.
2 A Bauddha deified sage.
E.
वीत gone, and राग passion, desire.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Peaceable, without hostile intentions.
E.
वीत, विरुद्ध opposed, and वुद्धि understanding.

mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं)
Fearless.
E.
वीत, and शङ्क fear.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Free from care or sorrow.
m. (-कः)
The Aśoka tree, (Jonesia Asoca.)
E.
वीत gone, and शोक sorrow.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Free from desire.
E.
वीत, and स्पृहा desire.

m. (-त्रः)
1 AGNI or fire.
2 The sun.
E.
वीति a horse. होत्र clarified butter, the usual offering or oblation with fire; also वीतिहोत्रक.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Unable or disinclined to reply, having no answer.
E.
वीत, and उत्तर answer.
